note: Example Buffer v1 API payload for week_01_mon_announce. Endpoint: POST https://api.bufferapp.com/1/updates/create.json

body_fields.text: <the post body extracted from linkedin_pilot/week_01_mon_announce.md — everything after the first --- separator, stripped>
body_fields.media[picture]: <URL of publicly hosted image OR file upload>

notes: For image attachment via Buffer API, the image must be publicly accessible via URL. If Hermes runs in an environment where linkedin_images/ files are not URL-accessible, upload them to a CDN or S3 bucket first and populate media[picture] with the resulting URL.
scheduled_at is a Unix epoch (seconds). Compute from publish_date + publish_time_local + publish_timezone.
profile_ids[] is Buffer's internal ID for the LinkedIn profile — retrieve once via GET /profiles.json and cache.
Buffer will handle the actual LinkedIn API call at scheduled_at time.
